text:
Sam: quick question — PR #6129 has a tiny id rename (userID -> user_id) + gofumpt touched a couple files. CI green but merge queue needs one more approval. can someone take a look?
Anika: on it, should be able to review in ~30m. ping me if urgent.
Ravi: I can do a quick skim now, mobile but can catch obvious nits.
Anika: skim done. two tiny things: (1) proto json_name mismatch, (2) import grouping in cmd/main.go after fmt. added comments on the PR.
Sam: thanks—proto nit is about keeping the json field as camelCase for consumers? snippet: ```proto
message User {
  string user_id = 1 [json_name = "userId"];
}
``` can we keep `json_name = "userId"`?
Maria: prefer keeping `json_name = "userId"` — downstream code expects camelCase. gofumpt changes are fine. we should avoid unnecessary public surface churn.
Ravi: makes sense. I can prepare a follow-up that preserves json_name and only applies formatting + import grouping. want me to force-push to the branch?
Anika: yes please. also run `gofumpt -w` locally and `gofmt -s` if you can, CI was picky about import order.
Sam: for clarity, the only functional change is the rename to `user_id` in proto field name, right? json_name stays the same?
Anika: yep — field name is snake_case on wire, json_name preserves camelCase for clients.
devops-bot: Merge queue position updated: PR 6129 -> position 3
Ravi: pushing a small commit now with: 
- run `gofumpt -w .`
- fix import groups in cmd/main.go
- keep `json_name = "userId"`
Will force-push in 2m.
Ravi: pushed -> force-pushed origin/pr-6129/rename-id + fixed imports. PTAL.
Anika: quick review: imports and fmt look good. left one nit about a comment wording, not required to block.
Sam: @Anika thanks — can you drop approval when ready?
Anika: approved. :+1:
Maria: approved as well.
devops-bot: PR 6129 merged to main by merge-bot at 5401234599
Sam: awesome, thanks everyone :tada: 
Ravi: nice, that was painless.
Anika: thanks for the quick turnaround.
Maria: thumbs up
